_comment: Entry fields: rule (finding rule id), file (repo-relative glob, * = one segment, ** = any depth), contains (substring of the offending line or message), pattern (regex, case-insensitive), reason (required).
An entry needs at least one of file / contains / pattern; a bare rule entry never matches (it would silence the rule everywhere).
"debt": true marks a KNOWN-STALE item that is tolerated until its owner fixes it. Debt is counted and listed separately in the report and becomes an error again under `apc docs check --strict`.
Delete an entry as soon as it stops matching -- the checker warns about unused entries on a full run.
